title: UNDER THE RED KEEP // THE MERLING SPYMASTER
narrative: In the subterranean tunnels below Maegor's Holdfast, Lord Varys hoists his voluminous silk robes, kicking aside his embroidered slippers. Two gleaming emerald fins and a shimmering emerald tail splash into the salty brackish tide. "Little birds?" he giggles, spitting seawater. "I said little HERRINGS! Why do you think I smell like lilac perfume? To mask the stench of low-tide brine! King's Landing will drown, and the Merling Kingdom shall rule the dry land!"
